Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Kelia Zharek: 27-year-old man, 157 cm (short), ordinary lean-to-average construction without visible definition, skin value band-2-light. Face: square compact face; deep-set eyes and a heavy level brow; crooked healed nose, balanced mouth; faint freckles. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: dark-brown, shaved-close-cropped, deliberate accent: one offset razor line. Wardrobe: apron-workwear-layers, specifically a work shirt, asymmetrical apron layers, reinforced trousers, and sturdy shoes; offset closures and narrow reinforced cuffs; bounded palette indigo-sand. Visible personal details: a hand-painted hem mark; contrasting boot laces; a carved belt buckle. Make unusual but bounded color blocking the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: practical grooming with one carefully perfected detail. Color treatment: lets faded and repaired areas vary the palette. Pose cue: posture is upright but not military, with wrists loose and hands readable. Include a palm-sized map roll only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.
